title: DeluxeSurvival
description: DeluxeSurvival adds Survival-like commands into your server.
body:
# SurvivalDeluxe

A lightweight but powerful survival plugin for Paper servers.

SurvivalDeluxe provides player warps, moderation tools, utility commands, and survival-focused features without the bloat of large plugin suites.

Perfect for SMPs, community servers, and survival networks.

---

## 👀 Preview 
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/194ea2114f9fdbe43c6afb4c5e5c3745502e26b3.png)

---

## ✨ Features

### 🌍 Player Warps

Create and share your own warp locations.

Commands:

- `/createwarp <name>`
- `/cw <name>`
- `/warp <name>`
- `/pw <name>`
- `/playerwarp <name>`

Features:

- Personal warp creation
- Fast teleportation
- Persistent YAML storage
- Multiple command aliases

---

### 🛡️ Moderation

Keep your server safe with built-in moderation tools.

Commands:

- `/ban <player> [reason]`
- `/tempban <player> <duration> [reason]`
- `/unban <player>`
- `/kick <player> [reason]`

Features:

- Permanent bans
- Temporary bans
- Kick players instantly
- Easy moderation workflow

---

### ⚙️ Utilities

Commands:

- `/deluxe help`
- `/deluxe reload`
- `/deluxe version`

Features:

- Simple administration
- Lightweight configuration
- Fast startup
- Easy management

---

## 📋 Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `survivaldeluxe.warp` | Use player warps |
| `survivaldeluxe.createwarp` | Create player warps |
| `survivaldeluxe.deluxe` | Use `/deluxe` |
| `survivaldeluxe.reload` | Reload the plugin |
| `survivaldeluxe.ban` | Ban players |
| `survivaldeluxe.tempban` | Temporarily ban players |
| `survivaldeluxe.unban` | Unban players |
| `survivaldeluxe.kick` | Kick players |
| `survivaldeluxe.admin` | Access all admin permissions |

---

## 📖 Commands

| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/warp <warp>` | Teleport to a warp |
| `/pw <warp>` | Teleport to a warp |
| `/playerwarp <warp>` | Teleport to a warp |
| `/createwarp <warp>` | Create a warp |
| `/cw <warp>` | Create a warp |
| `/ban <player> [reason]` | Ban a player |
| `/tempban <player> <duration> [reason]` | Temporarily ban a player |
| `/unban <player>` | Unban a player |
| `/kick <player> [reason]` | Kick a player |
| `/deluxe help` | View help |
| `/deluxe reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/deluxe version` | View plugin version |

---

## 📂 Data Storage

SurvivalDeluxe stores all data in simple YAML files:

```text
plugins/SurvivalDeluxe/
├── config.yml
├── warps.yml
└── bans.yml
```

No database required.

---

## 🚀 Why SurvivalDeluxe?

Many survival plugins try to do everything at once.

SurvivalDeluxe focuses on the features most survival servers actually use:

- Player Warps
- Moderation Tools
- Lightweight Design
- Simple Configuration
- Modern Paper Support
- Easy Setup

Install, start your server, and you're ready to go.

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+

---

## 📝 Planned Features

- Homes (`/sethome`, `/home`)
- Spawn System
- Random Teleport (`/rtp`)
- TPA Requests
- Kits
- Economy Support
- Player Shops
- Back Command
- Tab Completion
- Configurable Messages

---

### SurvivalDeluxe

**Simple. Powerful. Essential.**
